title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-022
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA technical reports, radar imagery, and internal memoranda regarding the investigation of radar data associated with the Japan Airlines flight 1628 sighting.

incidents.summary: Japan Airlines flight 1628 reported seeing unidentified traffic in their immediate area over Alaska, which controllers observed as a slow-moving target on radar.
incidents.explanation: FAA analysis concluded the radar returns were uncorrelated primary and beacon targets, a known electronic phenomenon caused by timing discrepancies in radar equipment.
incidents.quote: It is unfortunate that the uncorrelated target phenomena occurred just when a pilot was reporting seeing something outside his aircraft.
